For most of the time, your view is strengthened.
No matter what are your views and how much you agree with them, sometimes you have to stop for a moment and ask why are your views like that.

I'll go further and suggest that if your views aren't changing over time, something is wrong. You don't have to move from right to left or vice versa, but you have to be able to look back at what you said and believed two years ago and say, "well, I was only half right". The views that have shifted the least over time are the most suspect.

The best way is to read or talk with people who are non-crazy, and non-stupid, who see things differently from you. You don't have to agree, but you do have to understand how a non-crazy, non-stupid person can hold a view you disagree with. This sort of question is often resolved by viewing the situation from a different point aspect, a different context, which lends depth to your understanding.

Was the hardware equal for both systems? and what limits were placed on the game?
